description:
Build the callsite dispatch matrix from a multi-target CallSiteSummary. Pure function, unit-testable in isolation, no codegen.

INPUT: a CallSiteSummary (semantic.rs:55) whose targets.len() > 1 -- the union-receiver protocol case. Each CallTargetSummary (semantic.rs:27) has:
- callee: SelectedCallee (the existing impl FunctionId / its activation)
- surface_inputs: Vec<Ty> -- input[0] is the receiver narrowed to THIS impl's overlap = the per-arm type discriminant.

OUTPUT: a PatternDispatchPlan<Ty> (the same artifact entry-dispatch uses) with one arm per target, arm i -> body_id i, plus the parallel Vec of per-arm targets so fz-bin.1 can map arm i -> the impl call edge. Build via pattern_dispatch_from_source (dispatch_matrix::pattern): one PatternRow per target with a (PatternSubjectRef::Input(0), receiver_ty) precondition for built-in targets, or a Pattern::Struct{module,fields:[]} head for struct targets. Order struct arms before the map arm (a struct value is also a map).

HARVEST from the abandoned jobs/protocol_dispatch.rs: dispatcher_row + the struct-vs-builtin branch + the struct-before-map sort + struct_module_name transplant almost verbatim (change the arm source from ProtocolDispatch arms to CallSiteSummary targets; discriminant Ty comes from target.surface_inputs[0] instead of module_impl_target_ty). fz-bin.4 then deletes that file.

DISTINGUISH struct vs built-in target: a target whose impl is a struct impl needs a struct-shape head, not a Region::Type over the struct type (that path is unsound, fz-bv3). Derive struct-ness from the impl's owner/target module (module_struct_fields). Confirm the receiver Ty in surface_inputs[0] already encodes the nominal struct -- if so a Region::Type arm may suffice; verify against fz-bv3 before relying on it. For the goal fixture (list|range) both arms are built-in/struct-pattern and sound.

TEST: feed a synthetic 2-target summary (list, range) and assert the produced plan dispatches Input(0)::list -> arm0, ::range -> arm1, with a miss/residual arm. Keep it a pure unit test (no full pipeline).

comments.text: Harvest dispatcher_row / struct-vs-builtin / struct-before-map / struct_module_name from the α WIP jobs/protocol_dispatch.rs (see fz-bin.4). Change the arm source from ProtocolDispatch arms to CallSiteSummary targets; discriminant Ty = target.surface_inputs[0], not module_impl_target_ty.

title: Build the callsite dispatch matrix from a multi-target CallSiteSummary (pure)
